ld.name: Mild By Nature, Tear-Free Baby Shampoo & Body Wash, Peach, 12.85 fl oz (380 ml)
ld.description: Mild By Nature Tear-Free Baby Shampoo and Body Wash Lightly Peach Scented Featuring Evening Primrose and Linseed Oils Plus Soothing Calendula and Oat Kernel Extracts pH Balanced and Suitable for All Skin Types 1 Formulated Without Parabens, Sulfates, or Dyes No Animal Testing or Animal Ingredients Formulated to be Good for People and the Planet With sensitive skin, babies need a calming, mild cleanser to gently wash them without causing irritation. Mild By Nature Tear-Free Baby Shampoo and Body Wash is lightly scented with peach and features natural oils and extracts, helping to gently clean your baby's delicate hair and skin. Our special formula contains beneficial evening primrose and linseed oils. We’ve also added extracts from marigold flowers (calendula) and oat kernel, as well as colloidal oatmeal, all of which have been used to soothe and nourish sensitive skin for ages. This Shampoo and Body Wash has been formulated to thoroughly clean your baby from head to toe without using harsh, drying surfactants, making it mild enough for all babies, even newborns!
